description: i03 Local Maintenance Areas Flood Protection is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Water Resources. Boundaries of various types of public agencies with responsibilities that include in part or primarily flood control, system maintenance, and improvement. In California, there are a variety of political entites that are granted self-taxation powers under various California codes in order to perform the basic goal of flood management within an area. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Water Resources. Its tags are 2018.02.22, Boundary, California, Central Valley, DWR. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
